limitations: Full gate physical exit 0 is separate from census exit 1, Auto TLC exit 1 and joined chain exit 1. No overall Auto-TLC pass or clean-census claim.

Auto TLC omitted all 458 baseline modules under --no-sany and physically failed that comparison; its 156 model IDs and observables have zero regressions. The full-gate reference SANY panel is separate evidence.

Fixture agreements are core-reference shadow agreements; trace-refuted, trace-unconfirmed, refused and stopped rows remain negative or incomplete evidence. Canonical numeric 255 alone is not a verified error class.
Fallbacks and frontend-only results are not actual-core execution. Expected divergences are not strict agreements.
The 5457 individual process receipts belong to the fixture recorder. Auto and full gate preserve top-level physical receipts and reports; no separate receipt for every internal child is claimed.

Independent audit recomputes/binds execution evidence; it does not reimplement the evaluator or rerun every validator/oracle. Ordinary checking of simulation/DFID fixtures does not qualify those modes.

Local concurrent run timing earns no performance credit. Ten-model five-repeat performance, affected ablations, original-workload capacity and deep frontend campaigns remain separate source-bound obligations.
No M1/M2 completion, release qualification, remote capacity/performance qualification or default-engine cutover follows. No goldens, baselines or validation rules changed.
